# Camera Info

Reads the position, orientation and lens of a dataset camera.

`lfs.camera_info` · Input

## How to use

Choose a dataset camera by index or image name.\
Outputs use world coordinates; the scene must contain dataset cameras.

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Position | `Position` | lfs.vector | — | — | Camera centre in world coordinates. |
| Direction | `Direction` | lfs.vector | — | — | Unit direction pointing forward from the camera. |
| Up | `Up` | lfs.vector | — | — | Unit direction pointing toward the top of the image. |
| FOV | `FOV` | lfs.float | — | — | Vertical field of view in degrees. |
| Image Size | `Image Size` | lfs.vector | — | — | Image width and height in pixels; Z is zero. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Camera | `camera` | string | 0 | — | Dataset camera index or exact image name; the default 0 selects the first camera. |
